title: Relativistic magnetohydrodynamics from kinetic theory
summary: This thesis develops a kinetic-theory framework for relativistic dissipative magnetohydrodynamics under strong electromagnetic fields, motivated by quark-gluon plasma in heavy-ion collisions. Starting from the relativistic Boltzmann-Vlasov equation and using the method of moments within the 14-moment approximation, it derives causal second-order hydrodynamic equations for relativistic plasmas with increasing generality.
